The site's data-correct-answer values are candidate keys and are kept unverified; no official RU key was independently checked. Curated Science-core export contains 89 records from the source variant; 10 records labelled outside the core subject set are held in a separate review ledger. The official/current subject scope must not be assumed to prove every historical page variant; confirm each old session against an original source before promoting any record.
